title: 2673. Make Costs of Paths Equal in a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: We can do the following increments: - Increase the cost of node 4 one time. - Increase the cost of node 3 three times. - Increase the cost of node 7 two times. Each path from the root to a leaf will have a total cost of 9. The total increments we did is 1 + 3 + 2 = 6. It can be shown that this is the minimum answer we can achieve.
The two paths already have equal total costs, so no increments are needed.
